description:
Positioned within a secure and well-maintained complex, this beautifully presented two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers a light-filled layout with a warm and inviting feel throughout.

Combining comfort, convenience and low-maintenance living, this home is perfectly suited to those seeking an easy lifestyle in a highly connected location.

Timber flooring flows throughout the apartment, enhancing the spacious open-plan living and dining area which opens seamlessly onto a generous private courtyard — an ideal space to enjoy a quiet morning coffee, relaxed outdoor dining or entertaining with friends.

The kitchen is well-appointed with stainless steel appliances, gas cooking, ample cupboard and bench space, double sinks and an under-bench oven, all thoughtfully designed for practical everyday living.

Both bedrooms are well-sized and include built-in wardrobes, while the master bedroom features the added privacy of its own ensuite bathroom. A second bathroom and separate laundry complete the functional floorplan.

Residents can also enjoy access to the complex swimming pool, spa and BBQ facilities, adding to the relaxed lifestyle appeal this property offers.

Features include:

Two spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes
Two bathrooms, including ensuite to the master bedroom
Timber flooring throughout
Light-filled open-plan living and dining area
Well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances and gas cooking
Generous private courtyard
Split-system air conditioning
Separate laundry
Secure complex with allocated parking bay
Visitor parking available

The CAT bus service is right at your doorstep, and you are within walking distance to local cafes, restaurants, parklands, and the Swan River. Enjoy easy access to Perth CBD and nearby attractions, including Elizabeth Quay, Queens Gardens, WACA Ground, Gloucester Park, and Perth Mint, offering a connected and convenient lifestyle in one of Perth’s most sought-after neighbourhoods.

HOW TO VIEW THIS PROPERTY

Arranging an inspection is easy! Simply click the 'Make an enquiry' or 'email agent' button for that rental property. You then enter your details and choose an inspection time that suits you. An instant registration email and/or text message will be sent to you. Confirm your attendance by selecting 'register' PLEASE NOTE: If you do not register to attend, we can't notify you of any changes or cancellations to open. An open will be cancelled if no one has registered to attend.

Please ensure that you arrive on time to allow sufficient time for viewing the property, as viewing times cannot be extended.

APPLICATIONS
You may apply for this property prior to viewing, however, please note you will be required to either attend a home open or have someone view on your behalf.

To apply for this property, simply enquire or attend an inspection, and we will provide you with a link to apply.
